meta_types.meta.material_value: Any value of a declared LCL type excluding MISSING and UNKNOWN.
meta_types.meta.special_sentinel: MISSING or UNKNOWN; non-material and non-persistable.
meta_types.meta.addressable: PATH, URI, REFERENCE, or a host-bound addressable object.
meta_types.meta.mutable_target: An addressable target whose applicable scope and permission allow mutation.
meta_types.meta.ordered: A material-value domain whose actual members are mutually order-compatible under operators_and_functions_v0.1.0.json#/ordered_types and #/ordered_type_rules; MISSING and UNKNOWN are excluded.
meta_types.meta.execution_unit: TASK, PHASE, SEQUENCE, STEP, ACTION, or TEST reference.
meta_types.meta.rule_clause: ALLOW, FORBID, REQUIRE, PREFER, PRESERVE, or OVERRIDE reference.
